outfits.untertitel: Tap a piece: wear it, take it off or buy it.

tabinfo.haustier: Health, weight and mood are in the care sheet at home.
tabinfo.saison: Strawberries in summer, pumpkin in autumn — whatever is ripe is on the table.
tabinfo.rezepte: Recipes? Ask Gooby — he eats anything round.
tabinfo.einkaeufe: Your harvest goes straight into the fridge at home.

tabinfo.service: The tank fills itself every time you stop at a place.
tabinfo.finanzierung: Financing? We only take coins — cash on the counter.

tabinfo.postkarten: Every holiday sends a card — this is the archive.

tabinfo.abfluege: Flights to all nine destinations today — punctual as always.

Catch it! … Fine, I'll catch it.

Whoa, what a bang! My ears are still flapping.
